cfp.description: Submit your presentation for DevFest Toulouse 2026.
cfp.intro: DevFest Toulouse welcomes speakers from all backgrounds. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, your experience and passion matter. Submit a talk and share your knowledge with the community.
cfp.statusClosed: The CFP is now closed. Thank you for your submissions!
cfp.topicsDescription: Web, Cloud, Mobile, AI, Security, DevOps, Data, IoT... All tech topics are welcome. We also look for experience reports, inspiring talks and cross-cutting topics (culture, diversity, green IT).

sponsor.description: Discover our sponsorship packages for DevFest Toulouse 2026.
sponsor.intro: DevFest Toulouse is the opportunity to gain visibility among thousands of tech enthusiasts. Join us as a sponsor and benefit from unique exposure to the Toulouse tech community.
sponsor.whyVisibilityDesc: Get noticed by our attendees: developers, engineers, technical decision-makers and students.
sponsor.whyBrandDesc: Show your commitment to innovation and attract top tech talent.
sponsor.whyProductsDesc: Present your solutions and technologies directly to your target audience.
sponsor.whyNetworkDesc: Connect with the Toulouse tech community in a friendly and professional setting.
sponsor.noPlans: Sponsorship packages will be available soon.
sponsor.formIntro: Fill out the form below and we will send you our sponsorship brochure. We will get back to you shortly.
sponsor.preAnnouncementMessage: Sponsorships are opening soon. Sign up to be notified as soon as packages are available.
sponsor.soldOutMessage: All sponsor slots for this edition have been filled. See you next year! In the meantime, feel free to reach out with any questions.
